hypothesis_contract.null: A pre-London fade of pair-specific tail Asian-session displacement does not produce positive RAW walk-forward equity or does not make both full comparable months reach 2.0x under both normal and adverse costs.
hypothesis_contract.alternative: FX session handoff inventory rebalancing makes pair-specific tail Asian-session displacement mean revert after 06:00 UTC strongly enough for both full comparable months to reach 2.0x under normal and adverse costs.

training_only_family_selection.selection_basis: The family is an FX-specific session-handoff inventory-rebalancing hypothesis. The 75th percentile is a structural tail definition fixed before evaluation; no alternative quantile, direction, window or family was replayed or ranked by outcome.

signal_family_rule.name: PAIR_SPECIFIC_ASIAN_TAIL_DISPLACEMENT_HANDOFF_FADE
signal_family_rule.raw_exit_time_utc: 11:55 completed M5 close, unchanged raw-ledger horizon convention
signal_family_rule.threshold_formula: q[pair] = nearest-rank 75th percentile of abs(d[pair,day]) over 2026-03-11 <= day < 2026-05-01; rank = ceil(0.75*N)
signal_family_rule.entry_inequality: emit exactly one pair/day RAW signal iff abs(d[pair,day]) >= q[pair] and d[pair,day] != 0
signal_family_rule.tie_rule: d=0 emits no signal; equality with the frozen threshold emits a signal
signal_family_rule.missing_rule: missing pair or any completed 00:00-05:55 M5 bar fails closed for the entire UTC-day basket
signal_family_rule.chronology: Only bars completed by 05:55 are signal inputs. The 06:00 fill and every later bar cannot change the decision, direction or signal_id.

frozen_execution_contract.baseline: V31 inventory and exit state machine
frozen_execution_contract.weekend_gap: No synthetic bars. Finite max-age takes precedence at the next actual completed bar.
frozen_execution_contract.terminal_liquidation: Close every remaining sleeve at the last completed bar close of each evaluation period and realize terminal MTM.

cost_arm_contract.raw_price: mid with no spread, slippage, commission or financing
cost_arm_contract.base_price: frozen V7 actual BID/ASK, slippage, commission and financing
cost_arm_contract.adverse_price: frozen V7 adverse BID/ASK, slippage, commission and financing

rejection_contract.system_fail: Any frozen hash, chronology, source, arm-parity, V31 execution-rule, inventory cap, max-age, terminal MTM, authority, holdout, period, leverage, threshold or one-variable mismatch fails closed before result acceptance.
rejection_contract.profit_reject: Automatically reject if either full comparable month is below 2.0x in EXECUTABLE_BASE or ADVERSE_STRESS, or unopened holdout reproduction is absent.
rejection_contract.raw_edge_reason: FX_SESSION_HANDOFF_FADE_RAW_EDGE_ABSENT when walk-forward RAW equity is at or below 1.0.

forbidden: threshold or direction optimization by return
